Nova – Software of Healthcare Monitor
details:
1. Executive Summary

Software of Healthcare Monitor is a web-based health monitoring dashboard for astronauts on long-duration missions to the Moon and Mars. It centralizes 18 types of medical examinations into one simple interface that a non-physician Crew Medical Officer can use without real-time help from Earth.

The system features Nove, an AI voice assistant that guides the astronaut, AI Suggestions that analyze trends, and a Yesterday – Daily Checks panel for the 4 most critical daily tests: Blood Pressure (BP), ECG, Oxygen Saturation (SpO2), and Temperature & Breathing (Temp).

Our solution is based entirely on NASA HRP data, NASA Glenn, and CSA radiation research. It solves the core problem: when communication delay reaches up to 44 minutes round-trip to Mars, astronauts must diagnose, monitor, and act independently.

2. The Problem

 At every moment, an astronaut faces the challenges of space—including radiation, isolation, gravity, and a confined environment—which can impact the immune system and lead to cardiovascular issues. Astronauts must be empowered to monitor their own health and medical data, allowing them to assess their condition independently rather than waiting 44 minutes for a response from doctors back on Earth

3. NASA Data Used

All sources are official NASA and partner agency pages:

  • NASA HRP Hazards – 5 hazards RIDGE. Used to define the 18 exams.
  • NASA HRP Risks – Detailed risks: immune, heart, bone, SANS, sleep, DVT.
  • NASA HRP Ongoing Research – CIPHER, B-Complex, Immune Biomarkers, Standard Measures, Tempus Pro, Omics Archive.
  • CSA Radiation / CANS – Neutron radiation is ~30% of radiation in spacecraft. Justified Radiation Dose exam.
  • CSA Why Science in Space – Dual benefit: space health + Earth health (aging, osteoporosis).
  • NASA Glenn MIM Devices – Tempus Pro / Ambulance in a Box. One device for ECG, NIBP, ultrasound, vitals.

AI Disclosure

We used manus and claude code  in programming the frontend ( UI ) .

Meta AI for research and translation of NASA sources,. All medical facts were checked against NASA sources. 

4. Our Solution

Dashboard: right: Nova with you ( Ai chatbot ) + Nova AI  Analysis and Suggestions.

 Center: 18 Test Types. Right: Yesterday – Daily Checks.

Left : model hologram (full body scane ).

4. Our Solution – 18 Exams

  • 1. Blood Test   2. Urine Test   3. Saliva Test
  • 4. Sweat Test   5. Immune Test   6. DNA / Microbe Test
  • 7. Ultrasound   8. X-Ray   9. Eye / Retina Scan
  • 10. Vision Test   11. Blood Pressure   12. ECG
  • 13. Oxygen Saturation   14. Temperature & Breathing
  • 15. Sleep Test   16. Radiation Dose
  • 17. Skin / Wound Test   18. IV Fluid Test

5. How It Works

  • Step 1: Astronaut opens dashboard, sees Yesterday Checks + AI Suggestions.
  • Step 2: Says to Nove: Start Blood Pressure check. Nove guides him by messages.
  • Step 3: Device measures, result appears on monitor.
  • Step 4: AI compares result to personal baseline and NASA thresholds.
  • Step 5: AI Suggestions updates: Green = normal, Yellow = watch, Red = act now.
  • Step 6: a system with ai model ready to trained on earth health data 

6. Technology Used 

Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript  

Backend: Python, fastABI

7. Impact & Future Work

Impact on Space

Early detection of bone loss, heart issues, immune changes, radiation exposure, and SANS before they become emergencies. Reduces dependence on Earth.

Impact on Earth

  • Same dashboard can help remote clinics, bedridden patients, elderly care, and isolated areas where no doctor is nearby.
  • Can be used in hospitals with simple modification to the interface.

Future Work

  • Connect it to sensors: Bio-Monitor, sweat patch, Tempus Pro.
  • Add personal baseline AI using AVATAR organ-on-a-chip concept.
  • Add Mini X-Ray and IVGEN Mini when they fly within 1 year.
  • Add Arabic + English toggle, and 3D body visualization.
